verdict.rationale: Mollie runs its own hosted MCP server at mcp.mollie.com/mcp. The docs say it lets merchants 'utilize natural language for creating different resources in their Mollie account' through Claude Desktop, Cursor and VS Code. It covers 13 APIs, including Payments, Payment Links, Subscriptions, Customers and Balances, with scoped tokens. Natural-language operation depends on an external AI client, and the coverage list leaves out some areas such as refunds and chargebacks. missing for 10: built-in natural-language interface without a third-party AI client, coverage of the full API surface (e.g. refunds, chargebacks), independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
